labelChirho: Sadducee (member of the priestly aristocratic sect)
descriptionChirho: A member of the Sadducees, the Jewish priestly-aristocratic party that rejected belief in resurrection, angels, and spirits (Acts 23:8), and wielded significant political power through the temple establishment. All 14 NT occurrences refer to the same group across nominative, genitive, and accusative plural forms. Multilingual evidence is fully consistent: Swahili 'Masadukayo', Hindi 'Saddoukaiyon/Saduki', Korean 'Sadugaein', Arabic 'al-Sadduqiyyin', Spanish 'saduceos/Saddoukaioi'. The S76289 cluster (1x, accusative plural) is merely a case-form variant of S76287 (13x, genitive/nominative plural) with no semantic distinction whatsoever. All occurrences denote the same sectarian identity.
